verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own POS testing system: a test Customer Area, a test card, and simulated acquirer responses, used to confirm the test integration works before switching to live transactions. That is a real test environment kept apart from live payments. Adyen itself calls it a 'basic' system, testing depends on ordering a physical test card, and the docs never explicitly say test data is isolated from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the sandbox is isolated from production data, evidence of a fully software-simulated sandbox with no physical test card, test API endpoints/credentials usable by agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.
You can order an Adyen test card from your test Customer Area
Simulate various acquirer responses to test your handling of declined transactions.
